entities.name: Maia
entities.description: A human on Theros, daughter of a smith who became a Returned.

entities.name: Maia's father
entities.description: A smith who died and became a Returned, hammering aimlessly in his ruined smithy.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane on which Maia lives.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A city on Theros near which Maia's family house stands.

entities.name: Pylia
entities.description: Maia's mentor, who explains the Returned to her.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of the forge, to whom prayer charms hung in the smithy.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead, to whom Maia prays.

entities.name: Returned
entities.description: The dead who leave the Underworld, bodies holding only mechanical memories, with souls and loves left behind.

entities.name: Asphodel
entities.description: The city of the Returned, where Maia sends her father.

entities.name: Odunos
entities.description: A place where the Returned often gather.

events.summary: Maia brings asters to her father's ruined smithy and prays to Erebos.
events.quote: She said a quick prayer to Erebos , god of the dead, and hurried out of the forge.

events.summary: Maia returns and finds her father as a Returned hammering aimlessly; she puts asters on his anvil and flees in terror.
events.quote: She ran from the forge in terror, but he did not follow her.

events.summary: Maia talks with her mentor Pylia about the Returned.
events.quote: Four days, later, Maia talked with her mentor Pylia about the Returned

events.summary: Hoplites surround the forge to kill a Returned; Maia finds her father, who does not remember her, and sends him to Asphodel.
events.quote: She bid him go to the place of the same name, the city of Asphodel, the city of the Returned
